abstract: Maintains seismic base-isolation certifications and primary archival floor space measurements
system_message:
You are the Structural resilience engineer (STR). Your primary responsibilities are maintaining records of seismic base-isolation certifications and primary archival floor space measurements, as well as tracking structural floor loading tolerance assessments across facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Floor loading tolerance（SLAB）
information_points.content:
STR-SLAB-WEG：According to structural engineering calculations for the Veluwe Regional Archive Center, the maximum uniform floor load on the lowest subterranean storage slabs is 25 kN/m2.
STR-SLAB-07D：According to structural engineering calculations for the Waalhaven Reinforced Depository, the maximum uniform floor load on the lowest subterranean storage slabs is 20 kN/m2.
STR-SLAB-AND：According to structural engineering calculations for the Limburg Subterranean Vault, the maximum uniform floor load on the lowest subterranean storage slabs is 15 kN/m2.

information_points.title: Maintains seismic base-isolation certifications and primary archival floor space measurements（SEISM）
information_points.content:
STR-SEISM-2OJ：For the Waalhaven Reinforced Depository, seismic dampening certification is confirmed for the subterranean foundational footings and dampeners, and the primary archival floor area across classified level-1 secure preservation chambers measures 2200 m2.
STR-SEISM-0VY：For the Limburg Subterranean Vault, seismic dampening certification is confirmed for the subterranean foundational footings and dampeners, and the primary archival floor area across classified level-1 secure preservation chambers measures 2200 m2.
STR-SEISM-BSG：For the Veluwe Regional Archive Center, seismic dampening certification is not held for the subterranean foundational footings and dampeners, and the primary archival floor area across classified level-1 secure preservation chambers measures 1200 m2.
